assets.name: mist-pale-v79
assets.title: Pale mint mist
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided mist ribbon. Preserve transparent wide canvas and broad horizontal ribbon placement. Refine this into a SIMPLE AIRY cartoon mist ribbon in pale mint white, for a small mobile map decoration. Remove ALL internal bands, all wave-like strokes, all dark underside shading, all top rim highlights. There must be only one smooth gentle color field. Reduce the top silhouette to TWO very low broad rounded gentle humps. The top contour is smooth and slightly crisp, body immediately below is translucent vapor that gradually vanishes into genuine alpha transparency downward, with NO visible lower boundary. Ends fade into transparency. Strongly avoid cloth, mountain ridges, ocean waves, layered ribbons, 3D shading or glossy surface. Very simple flat color with softly fading ALPHA. Actual transparent background and partially transparent body, no baked background. No scenery, shadows, glow or particles. Keep ample transparent margin.
assets.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated horizontal translucent mist ribbon sprite for a polished colorful 2D mobile world map. Subject: ONE thin low-lying bank of pale mint-white fog, shaped like a long flowing horizontal ribbon with three very low smooth rolling humps along its top, soft near-flat underside dissolving gradually into transparency, gently tapered ends. Shape wider than tall, approximately 5:1 visible silhouette within a wide 3:1 canvas, centered with transparent margins. Simple clean stylized gradient shading, smooth broad curved shapes, no texture or small details. The fog is translucent vapor with gentle white-mint upper contour and muted cool mint softly shaded body. Reference aesthetic: the small pale mist ribbons entering from the edge of a candy mobile map, hovering low above grass, airy and elegant, no dense cloud puff. Real transparent alpha background AND softly varying partially transparent alpha inside the mist, do not bake in a checkerboard or black. Mist must reveal the grass through it. No scenery, grass, sky, hills, mountains, liquid, container, particles, glitter, stars, text, hard outline, cast shadow, neon, glare, smoke turbulence, photorealistic cloud. Not glossy plastic: diffuse ethereal fog.
